title: Can I MASTER Capture Anything Chess?
summary: chess.com Capture Anything vs online humans (~1470-1700): you may capture any piece, including your own. Goal: win five games. Opponents often seemed confused (giving away pieces, resigning in positions that weren't mate because a self-capture escapes), and he wins all five without a loss, crossing 1700 in the grouped variant rating.
rules: Any piece may capture any other piece, enemy OR friendly (e.g. Rxh2 capturing your own pawn to open a file).
Kings cannot be captured (normal check/checkmate apply); a self-capture can be used to escape or block check (inferred from 'Oh, of course it's not checkmate').

board.theme_notes: chess.com green board; thumbnail knight capturing its own pawn.

visual_fx: Capture rings also drawn on your own pieces.
current_impl_issues: Legacy 'captureany' matches (own-piece capture, not the king).
evidence: SRT 0:00 'capture Anything Chess where you can capture anything including your own pieces. My goal is to win five games'; 0:30 'I can literally just play rook takes H2'; 4:50 'Oh, of course it's not checkmate'; 5:30 'first time... I cross 1700'; 11:10 'we do win game number five... Didn't lose a single one'.
